highlights: The app now works on iPad, iPhone Duo and Android foldables. On a wide screen, the chat list stays beside the open chat.
Tap the activity row of a working agent to read each thought of the turn in full, live.
Settings › Notifications is the one place for notifications: choose All, Needs me or Off for each server and agent, on all your devices.
When a new version is available, home shows an update header, and What's new shows the release notes.
Code blocks in chat wrap long lines, so you can read a long command without scrolling sideways.
